title: Tune-In Lounge | Walt Disney World Resort
body_text: Tune-In Lounge Located in Echo Lake at Disney's Hollywood Studios Sip specialty cocktails while watching 50’s TV at this retro hot spot! Add some thrills ‘n’ chills to your lemonade with experimental “electric ice cubes" that light up the room! A full bar is also available.View Menu American Bar-Lounge Dining Plan Meals Not Accepted Operating Hours – 10:45 AM to 9:30 PM Valid admission required.
